_readme: Append-only log of weekly forward-test cohorts. Each cohort is an independent Rs 1,00,000 paper portfolio, decided once and priced off the prior Friday's close. NEVER edit an existing cohort's holdings/entry_price/shares/entry_date after creation -- that would destroy the forward-test (no-hindsight) integrity this file exists to guarantee. New cohorts are appended by the paper-trading-weekly scheduled task every Monday. Mark-to-market values live in RETURNS_TRACKER.md (regenerated), not here.

cohorts.note: Started off-cycle on a Tuesday to begin tracking immediately, rather than waiting for the next Monday (2026-08-31). All subsequent cohorts start strictly on Monday per the scheduled task.
